dct_description_sm: The main goals of this study were to evaluate Fusarium head blight (FHB) resistance in a synthetic hexaploid derived wheat (SHDW) spring wheat population, identify new sources of resistance to FHB, determine single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) markers associated with FHB resistance, and identify FHB resistance candidate genes.
dct_title_s: Replication data for: Identification of fusarium head blight resistance markers in a genome-wide association study of CIMMYT spring synthetic hexaploid derived wheat lines
